# StudyX

> > StudyX is an AI-powered learning platform offering personalized tutoring, homework help, and automated note-taking across multiple subjects and languages.

StudyX leverages advanced AI models like GPT-4 and Gemini to provide step-by-step solutions, instant answers to academic questions, and tools for converting video lectures, PDFs, and slides into organized study notes. The platform supports multilingual learning with dedicated versions in Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and other languages.

## Key Topics

- AI Tutor
- Homework Help
- Personalized Learning
- Step-by-Step Solutions
- Automated Note-Taking
- AI Video Summarizer
- Multi-Subject Support
- Image Recognition
- Video Lecture Notes
- AI Transcription
- Educational Tools
- Ask AI Questions
- Study Efficiency
- Math Solver
- Multilingual Support

## Core AI Learning Tools

- [Ask AI Questions - Get Free & Instant Answers | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/ask-ai-questions): Main AI question-answering service for academic & everyday queries
- [AIチューター | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/ja/ai-tutor): Japanese version of StudyX AI Tutor for personalized learning support
- [Tutor de IA | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/es/ai-tutor): Spanish version of StudyX AI Tutor with step-by-step solutions
- [IA de Matemática - Solucionador e Calculadora de Matemática com IA Gratuito | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/pt/math-ai): Portuguese AI math solver using GPT-4 & Gemini for step-by-step solutions

## AI Note-Taking & Study Tools

- [AI PowerPoint 要約ツール - 高速＆無料 | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/ja/slide-summary): Japanese AI tool converting PowerPoint slides to organized study notes
- [Preneur de Notes IA - Obtenez des Notes Gratuites en Secondes | StudyX](https://studyx.ai/fr/ai-note-taker): French AI note-taking tool converting videos, PDFs & slides to notes
- [How to Take Notes from Video Lectures Automatically](https://studyx.ai/blog/how-to-take-notes-from-video-lectures-automatically): Guide on using AI Video Summarizer for automated lecture note-taking
